keyPriority.fallbackDesc: By default, if your key encounters a rate limit or failure, OpenRouter will fall back to using shared OpenRouter credits.
keyPriority.alwaysUseDesc: You can configure individual keys with "Always use this key" to prevent any fallback to OpenRouter credits. When this option is enabled, OpenRouter will only use your key for requests to that provider. This may result in rate limit errors if your key is exhausted, but ensures all requests go through your account.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Plans for indie hackers, AI native startups, and enterprises

tokenBilling.question: How are tokens billed?
tokenBilling.answer: Tokens are billed based on model usage and API calls.

markupPricing.question: Do you mark up provider pricing?
markupPricing.answer: Pricing depends on provider rates and usage tiers.

billingStructure.question: How is billing structured for BYOK, Pay-As-You-Go vs Enterprise?
billingStructure.answer: Enterprise plans offer volume pricing and custom agreements.

apiLimits.question: What are the API rate limits for each plan?
apiLimits.answer: Free plans have 50 requests/day, Pay-as-you-go has high global limits, and Enterprise has optional dedicated limits.

modelAccess.question: Do I get access to all AI models?
modelAccess.answer: Free plans include 25+ free models, while paid plans include access to 300+ models from 60+ providers.

dataRetention.question: How long is my data retained?
dataRetention.answer: Data retention periods vary by plan and can be configured in your privacy settings.

supportChannels.question: What support channels are available?
supportChannels.answer: Free users get community support, Pay-as-you-go gets email support, and Enterprise gets dedicated Slack channel support.

apiCompatibility.question: Is OpenRouter compatible with OpenAI SDK?
apiCompatibility.answer: Yes, OpenRouter is fully compatible with OpenAI SDK and works out of the box.

creditExpiration.question: Do credits expire?
creditExpiration.answer: Credits don't expire and can be used with any model or provider in our network.

customModels.question: Can I use custom models?
customModels.answer: Enterprise plans support custom model deployments and fine-tuned models.

autoTopUp.question: How does auto top-up work?
autoTopUp.answer: Auto top-up automatically adds credits when your balance drops below a threshold you set.

dataPrivacy.question: How is my data protected?
dataPrivacy.answer: We implement enterprise-grade security with configurable data policies and privacy controls.

multipleOrgs.question: Can I have multiple organizations?
multipleOrgs.answer: Yes, you can create and manage multiple organizations for different teams or projects.

bulkDiscounts.question: Are there bulk discounts available?
bulkDiscounts.answer: Enterprise plans offer volume pricing and bulk discounts based on usage commitments.

slaGuarantees.question: Do you offer SLA guarantees?
slaGuarantees.answer: Enterprise plans include 99.9% SLA guarantees with contractual commitments.

apiKeyManagement.question: How do I manage API keys?
apiKeyManagement.answer: You can create, rotate, and manage API keys with credit limits and expiration dates.

promptCaching.question: What is prompt caching?
promptCaching.answer: Prompt caching reduces costs and latency by caching frequently used prompts and responses.

fallbackProviders.question: What happens if a provider goes down?
fallbackProviders.answer: OpenRouter automatically falls back to other providers to ensure high availability.

websocketSupport.question: Do you support WebSocket streaming?
websocketSupport.answer: Yes, we support real-time streaming for chat completions and other interactive use cases.

batchProcessing.question: Can I process requests in batches?
batchProcessing.answer: Yes, we support batch processing for efficient handling of large volumes of requests.

modelComparison.question: How do I compare different models?
modelComparison.answer: Use our model comparison tool to evaluate performance, pricing, and capabilities across models.

costOptimization.question: How can I optimize costs?
costOptimization.answer: Use auto-routing, prompt caching, and our cost monitoring tools to optimize your spending.

enterpriseFeatures.question: What enterprise features are included?
enterpriseFeatures.answer: Enterprise includes SSO/SAML, dedicated support, custom SLAs, and advanced security controls.

dataExport.question: Can I export my usage data?
dataExport.answer: Yes, you can export activity logs and usage data in various formats including CSV and JSON.

regionalDeployment.question: Do you offer regional deployments?
regionalDeployment.answer: Enterprise customers can request regional deployments for data residency requirements.

modelVersioning.question: How do you handle model versioning?
modelVersioning.answer: We support multiple versions of models and provide migration paths for deprecated versions.

troubleshooting.question: How do I troubleshoot API issues?
troubleshooting.answer: Use our comprehensive logs, error codes documentation, and support channels for troubleshooting.

scalability.question: How does OpenRouter scale with my needs?
scalability.answer: Our infrastructure auto-scales to handle traffic spikes and growing usage patterns.

integrations.question: What integrations do you support?
integrations.answer: We integrate with popular development tools, monitoring platforms, and cloud services.

compliance.question: What compliance standards do you meet?
compliance.answer: We comply with SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, and other industry-standard compliance frameworks.

backupRecovery.question: What backup and recovery options exist?
backupRecovery.answer: We maintain automated backups and offer point-in-time recovery for enterprise customers.

performanceMonitoring.question: How can I monitor API performance?
performanceMonitoring.answer: Use our analytics dashboard and integrate with observability platforms for performance monitoring.

customRouting.question: Can I customize model routing?
customRouting.answer: Yes, you can configure custom routing rules based on cost, performance, or data policies.

tokenLimits.question: Are there token limits per request?
tokenLimits.answer: Token limits vary by model. Check our documentation for specific limits and capabilities.

experimentalFeatures.question: Do you offer experimental features?
experimentalFeatures.answer: Yes, we regularly release experimental features for testing new capabilities and models.

partnerProgram.question: Do you have a partner program?
partnerProgram.answer: Yes, we offer partnership opportunities for resellers, integrators, and technology partners.

academicPricing.question: Is there academic or non-profit pricing?
academicPricing.answer: We offer special pricing for educational institutions and qualifying non-profit organizations.

migrationSupport.question: Do you help with migration from other platforms?
migrationSupport.answer: Yes, our team provides migration assistance and best practices for switching from other AI platforms.

customTraining.question: Can you help with custom model training?
customTraining.answer: Enterprise customers can work with our team for custom model training and fine-tuning services.

multiRegionSupport.question: Do you support multi-region deployments?
multiRegionSupport.answer: Yes, we offer multi-region support for global applications requiring low latency access.

errorHandling.question: How should I handle API errors?
errorHandling.answer: Implement exponential backoff, check error codes, and use our retry mechanisms for robust error handling.

webhookSupport.question: Do you support webhooks for notifications?
webhookSupport.answer: Yes, we support webhooks for usage alerts, billing notifications, and system status updates.

loadBalancing.question: How does load balancing work?
loadBalancing.answer: We automatically distribute requests across providers and regions for optimal performance and reliability.

securityAudits.question: Do you conduct security audits?
securityAudits.answer: We undergo regular security audits and penetration testing to maintain the highest security standards.

apiVersioning.question: How do you handle API versioning?
apiVersioning.answer: We use semantic versioning and provide backward compatibility with clear deprecation timelines.

developerTools.question: What developer tools do you provide?
developerTools.answer: We offer SDKs, CLI tools, testing frameworks, and comprehensive documentation for developers.

usageAnalytics.question: What usage analytics are available?
usageAnalytics.answer: Get detailed insights into usage patterns, costs, performance metrics, and model effectiveness.

communitySupport.question: Is there a developer community?
communitySupport.answer: Yes, join our Discord community for discussions, support, and to share experiences with other developers.

featureRequests.question: How can I request new features?
featureRequests.answer: Submit feature requests through our feedback channels or community forums for consideration.

emergencySupport.question: Do you offer emergency support?
emergencySupport.answer: Enterprise customers receive priority emergency support with guaranteed response times.

dataProcessing.question: How do you process sensitive data?
dataProcessing.answer: We offer configurable data processing options including on-premises and private cloud deployments.

modelUpdates.question: How often are models updated?
modelUpdates.answer: Models are updated regularly as providers release new versions. We notify users of significant changes.

costPrediction.question: Can I predict usage costs?
costPrediction.answer: Use our cost calculator and budgeting tools to predict and control usage costs effectively.

concurrentRequests.question: What are the concurrent request limits?
concurrentRequests.answer: Concurrent request limits scale with your plan and can be increased for enterprise customers.

testingEnvironment.question: Do you provide testing environments?
testingEnvironment.answer: Yes, we offer sandbox environments for testing and development without affecting production usage.
